name: ad-image-localization
description: Localize and resize ad image creatives with no image model by rebuilding them in HTML/CSS and rendering every language x size.

interface.shortDescription: Localize and resize ad images by rebuilding them in code
interface.longDescription: Decompose a flat ad into layers, rebuild it as a responsive HTML page with live text, and render every language and size (1:1 to 320x50) with DOM QA, WCAG contrast checks, RTL layouts, manifests, and a release gate. No image-generation model required.
defaultPrompt: Use ad-image-localization to localize this ad into German, Japanese and Arabic in all standard sizes.
Rebuild this creative with ad-image-localization and render the full IAB display pack.
